name: Nase Yukana
source:
Yohei's younger sister. She is a third year middle school student who looks forward to attending high school with her brother next year.

Desperately in love with her brother, Yohei, despite being embarrassed by it. Her love for her brother causes her to act sweet to him sometimes while her embarrassment causes her to become angry at him at other times.
